UiWidgetBundle.description: Generic, caller-driven ranked/prioritized table for HXL rendering in Agentforce and MCP channels. The agent supplies columns + rows as a JSON spec (via RankedTableAction / Get Ranked Table); the action flattens them into columns[] + rows[].cells[] so the card binds with plain forEach only. Serves opportunity prioritizer, portfolio analysis, outreach advisor, weekly replanning, and claims triage.
